name: Dropbear SSH
author: Akshay
description: SSH and SFTP over your existing WiFi, no USB networking needed. Launching opens a status app with a Start/Stop button that shows the connect command and password while the server is running, a field for setting your own password, a Check for Update button, and a "Keep reachable while Kindle sleeps" option that defers the device's suspend cycle so the server stays reachable through sleep (costs battery, since WiFi and CPU stay up; the e-ink screen does not). The server keeps running after the app is closed. Buttons talk to a loopback-only bridge on the device, not to any external server. A random password is generated at install and printed in the KPM log; change it from the app or at /mnt/us/usbnetlite/etc/ssh_password. Verified on Paperwhite 4 (kernel 4.1.x), Paperwhite 5 (4.9.77), and Paperwhite 6 / Véra (5.15.x). Ships two binary builds per upstream's release split, selected automatically by kernel version at install time. Repackaged from notmarek/kindle-usbnetlite.
